name: Macadamia Nuts
siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to high fat content and absence of FODMAPs. The high fat content may slow gastric emptying, which can be beneficial for some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Store in airtight container in refrigerator to maintain freshness
Toast lightly to enhance flavor without adding FODMAPs
Chop or crush to make portion control easier
Choose raw or dry-roasted varieties over flavored ones that may contain garlic or onion
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in monounsaturated fats for heart health
Good source of manganese and thiamine
High in healthy omega-7 palmitoleic acid
